## SK Hynix Expanding South Korea Production Capacity Explicitly to Meet AI Memory Demand

Demand-pull capacity expansion from the HBM market leader is a constructive read for the entire AI memory supply chain and validates that HBM demand remains growth-constrained rather than supply-constrained; a positive read-across for AI infrastructure capex names more broadly.

- SK Hynix is increasing output at its South Korea facilities, with AI memory demand cited as the explicit driver.
- The expansion is demand-pull in nature — not speculative capacity addition — reinforcing the signal value.
- Domestic capacity expansion at SK Hynix supports its stated strategy of maintaining HBM supply leadership.
- The move is a direct confirmation that AI memory demand is robust enough to justify near-term capex commitment from the market leader.
